title: Plotting feature values against attributions
description: You can follow selected feature columns into dependence scatterplots.

steps.description: You loop over three entries from the existing ordg ordering. Each entry selects a feature index j.
xs reverses scaling for the selected test values using sig and mu. ys selects that feature's attribution column from Phi.

steps.question: Does the loop overlay all features on one figure?
steps.answer: No. It creates a new figure inside each iteration before drawing that feature's scatterplot.

steps.description: You label the horizontal axis in raw units and the vertical axis with the feature attribution. The supplied recording has no rendered plots or text output to inspect.
